sanskrit: yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ brajet mukto bhavatītyarthaḥ hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulikī kulanāyikā śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaram kathayāmi sureśāni sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam dehādeścidaikātmyopapādakamupāyaṃ kathayāmi vravīmi tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau kālayogena ca pravartante iti bāhyo'rthaḥ śliṣṭaḥ sugamaḥ kramāt kādiṣu varṇeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate mano'haṅkārabuddhiprakṛtipuruṣākhyapañcakam tadūrdhvaṃ śādi vikhyātaṃ purastādbrahmapañcakam prāṇapratiṣṭhayā amṛtena hṛdyavatāraṇaṃ vāruṇīdhāraṇā ghanībhāvo'parāvākvapuṣi tiṣṭhan vaikharīrūpaṃ sphuṭī bhavati sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasvini caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam svacchandabhairavasya hṛdayaṃ sārabhūto mahāmantraḥ etannāyoginījāto nārudro labhate sphuṭam asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅmantramudrāgaṇo mahān āveśo devānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣma yatra saṃmukhatvaprāptau muhūrta smarate yastu cummakenābhimudritaḥ atītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo'sau kathayatyapi vyabhicaratītyarthaḥ sākṣātpaśyatyasaṃdigdhamākṛṣṭaṃ rudraśaktibhiḥ parameśaśaktiṃbhirvrāhmyādibhirākṛṣṭaṃ noditam trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogeśvaryo mahābalāḥ

āgatya samayaṃ labdhvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ phalaṃ tad dāsyanti anena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥ samādheraghoramantrataśca siddhyati adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ yaḥ kiñcidvetti tattvataḥ karmānuṣṭhānādapi anuttaro'tyutkṛṣṭaḥ anena jñātamatreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati dīkṣāyā yajanaṃ prati vidhānajño jāyate śivo viśvādyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam śāntā - śāntyatītāditrayaṃ sūkṣmamutkṛṣṭaṃ ca matam aṇurviśuddhamacirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamaśnute vācyāḥ sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchastṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagadetaccarācaram kiñcidasamañjasam dīkṣā bhavatyasaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā raṇamanapekṣamāṇā, nātra saṃśayaḥ nyāsaṃ kṛtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃśatimantritām śikhāṃ baddhvā tālatrayaṃ purā datvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye iti | saśabdaṃ tālatrayaṃ dattvā pratyūhopaśamanāya puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅge vā sthaṇḍile'thavā puṣpeṇa iti puṣpāsanādikāṃ pūjāṃ kuryāt tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ yajedvīraḥ punarevāsanaṃ tataḥ

pūjāmārabhet | ātmāmarśanamevābhyantarī pūjā sarvatattvasusaṃpūrṇā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaistu yathāśaktyā samarcayet evaṃ yajanamākhyātamagnikārye'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ jñānadhārāmadhirohati ādyantarahitaṃ bījaṃ vikasattithimadhyagam gāni yogasya ityādayo yogaśāstroktāḥ iti yānyān kāmayate kāmāṃstāṃstāṃ śīghramavāpnuyāt prādurbhavati evaṃ mantraphalāvāptirityetadrudrayāmalam bhūyāmamityāśāsmahe
